business_problem: WEIDER Probiotics needed to provide instant, personalized product guidance without the wait times, staffing overhead, or impersonal interactions that came with traditional customer-service teams and basic chatbots.
solution_summary: WEIDER Probiotics and MagV CO built an always-on virtual product expert on NVIDIA Avatar Cloud Engine so customers can ask detailed health and product questions at any time. The deployment combines high-fidelity 3D-scanned avatars, custom Mandarin language models, real-time facial animation, and secure cloud delivery into a single conversational service grounded in WEIDER's proprietary research and product documentation. NVIDIA ACE 5.0 acts as the modular microservice layer tying the avatar runtime and model services together, while NVIDIA L4 GPUs provide the low-latency inference capacity needed for responsive multiuser sessions. That stack turns brand knowledge into a human-like digital ambassador that can scale to more languages, products, and markets without rebuilding the core experience or staffing a larger human support operation.

data_flow: Customer questions are passed into the ACE-based service, where custom Mandarin models use WEIDER's proprietary research and product documentation to generate answers. The platform renders those answers through a 3D avatar with real-time facial animation, and NVIDIA L4 GPUs keep the cloud-hosted service responsive for concurrent users.
business_outcome: WEIDER lowered customer-service operating overhead, delivered responses in less than two seconds, and created a support channel that can serve users continuously while scaling to additional languages, products, and markets.
